Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: character production concept sheet for original fighting game GALE BREAKER: ELEMENTAL CLASH. Input image 1 is a STYLE AND CHARACTER CONTINUITY reference from the approved v2 sheet, not the simplified low-poly v3. Match its polished hand-painted stylized 3D concept quality, convincing volume, controlled painterly cel-shading, readable anatomy and costume materials. Warm off-white paper background, one large full-body three-quarter main pose including feet, one smaller clear back view, a head detail and a small material/equipment study. Sparse elegant layout with substantial breathing room. A small 'GALE BREAKER / CHARACTER REVISION' heading, the character name clearly printed once, a few color swatches, no paragraphs or tiny illegible notes. This is a redesign of ONE character only. No other characters, no watermark, no existing franchise likeness. Follow the new specification below over the old reference design.
CHARACTER NAME: "TOPHIA". Adult female earth fighter, formidable and proud. New visual direction: a COMPLETE suit of KNIGHT-STYLE ARMOR MADE ENTIRELY OF ORANGE STONE covering EVERY PART OF HER BODY BELOW THE HEAD. Only her head is exposed. Short straight BLACK hair in a practical cropped/pixie cut, no long hair, no ponytail, absolutely no buns. Recognizable serious feminine face. The orange stone armor has a high protective gorget reaching to the base of the head, full enclosed breastplate and backplate, massive fitted stone pauldrons, upper-arm plates, enclosed elbow joints, forearm armor, solid articulated STONE GAUNTLETS COVERING ALL FINGERS, stone waist/tassets, fully covered hips and thighs, closed knee joints, stone greaves and solid stone sabatons. No visible chest skin, no bare neck below the gorget, no exposed arms, wrists, fingers, midriff, thighs, legs or toes. No cleavage. No black fabric gaps or bare flexible undersuit showing between plates. Armor is a magically mobile earth shell: it can articulate with interlocking overlapping rock segments without physically realistic cloth gaps; this is an intentional game fantasy. She can move dynamically despite the solid full-body stone coverage. The silhouette evokes a powerful medieval knight, with broad shoulders and heroic grounded proportions, not a rock bikini or a robe with a few rock plates. Material must read as real matte burnt-orange sandstone/terracotta-colored natural rock with chunky chipped facets, subtle darker orange crevices and restrained mineral striations; NOT metal painted orange, NOT gray rock, NOT shining gold, NOT lava, NOT flaming armor. Keep larger solid masses and a buildable consistent structure, avoid thousands of small shards. Dynamic confident wide fighting stance with torso twist and one fully stone-armored fist forward, weight and mobility together. No helmet because her head is the only uncovered part; no sword, shield, guns or additional weapon. Show back view with the same complete orange rock coverage, and head study showing clearly SHORT BLACK HAIR. Material study of one orange stone gauntlet and rock chip. Palette orange rock, darker rust crevices, black hair, natural skin only on head.

CHARACTER NAME: "VOLT". A resourceful young ADULT male junkyard tinkerer, about 20, lean agile build. Keep short messy BLOND HAIR WITH SINGED BROWN/BLACK TIPS from the reference, a few soot smudges on youthful face, eyes visible. Entire armor aesthetic now made recognizably out of SCRAP AND TRASH: dented rusted appliance panels, mismatched battered sheet metal, a plastic container lid repurposed as one shoulder pad, tire-rubber straps, a few flattened can pieces, recycled bottle-cap fasteners, salvaged cable and a beat-up compact scavenged battery pack. The viewer should instantly understand he assembled it out of discarded household junk, not bought polished high-tech armor. Functional stylized readable silhouette, deliberate asymmetry, large identifiable salvaged components, restrained quantity of parts. Worn dark work shirt and patched trousers underneath, scuffed improvised boots. Colors dull rust, dirty mustard plastic, scratched faded blue, graphite rubber; small electric CYAN energy accents supply the lightning identity. No clean factory white sci-fi plates, no elegant matching exoskeleton, no luxurious materials. His SIGNATURE WEAPON is one chunky HAND CANNON held in one hand, firmly gripped, dominant and immediately legible: an oversized short-barreled fictional improvised blaster assembled from a battered canister-like shell, repurposed pipe-shaped casing and junk plates, with a single cyan-lit energy chamber and a chunky round muzzle. This is a fantastical video-game energy cannon, not a realistic firearm or engineering diagram. Show a confident three-quarter combat-ready pose presenting the cannon, his other hand free for balance; do not replace both arms with guns, do not give him twin tonfas, swords or rifles. The cannon should feel weighty but believable for him to wield as his game weapon. Include a simple painted side-view weapon study showing only external design with no internal functional schematic, a rear character view showing the improvised battery and straps, and head study of scorched blond hair. Maintain recognizable human silhouette and appealing ingenuity rather than a heap of unstructured garbage.
